name: Shukuri Akito
source:
Hot-tempered and always wearing a displeased expression, Akito is a moody young man. He's hostile and dislikes being made fun of or looked down upon. Akito's a good cook, and his meals are praised for tasting "like Mum's". He's not good with birds.

His route is only accessible when the player selects Nanami as the protagonist.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.otomate.jp/norn9/vita/chara/?page=akito]official website profile[/URL]]

[spoiler]His real name is Ichinose Akito.[/spoiler]
